chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Husayn ibn Ali from Aban from one of his companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
I asked him about coming to the women in their behinds, so he said: 'She is your plaything, do not hurt her'. She is your plaything, do not hurt her'.

key_terms.لَا تُؤْذِهَا: Do not hurt her / cause her pain
key_terms.لُعْبَتُكَ: Your plaything / toy (indicating permissibility and flexibility)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on anal intercourse with one's wife in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) affirms the permissibility of anal intercourse with one's wife, characterizing it as 'your plaything' (lu'batuka) to denote its flexibility within marital relations. However, he imposes the crucial ethical constraint of 'do not hurt her' (la tu'diha), a principle that Shia jurists interpret broadly to include both physical pain and emotional distress, thereby balancing permissibility with marital courtesy (mu'asharah bil-ma'ruf).
